name: Disco Party

features.name: Pick your character
features.description: Male lead (medium) or female lead (low) volatility.

features.name: Adaptive symbols
features.description: High-paying symbols change to match your choice.

review:
A nightclub dating game where your character choice sets the volatility: the male lead plays at medium volatility, the female lead at low, and the high symbols change to match. It's a genuinely neat way to learn what volatility means.

Two free spins rounds multiply your winning matchups. 243 ways, a 1,500x cap and a 97.01% RTP, with free spins about once every 123 spins. Light, fun and easy to play for a while.
pros: Excellent 97.01% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 123 spins on average)
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
